description: This class defines a data model for PSK (Pre-Shared Key) secrets, extending a common secret class. It includes a byte array for the secret key, getter and setter methods, validation, and overrides for string representation.

classes.name: PskSecret
classes.description: Represents a PSK secret, encapsulating the secret key and providing validation.

methods.name: getKey
methods.description: Returns the secret key as a byte array.

methods.name: setKey
methods.description: Sets the secret key with a byte array, enabling fluent API style.

methods.name: toStringHelper
methods.description: Provides a custom string representation including the key.

methods.name: checkValidity
methods.description: Validates that the key is set and not empty, throwing an exception if invalid.
